title: AUM figure requires link to AUM breakdown
description: Where AUM figures are included, a link to the report on AUM by geography and asset class on the website must be given.
source_clause: Internal Performance checklist item 18; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

pass.content: Total AUM: ₹8,421 cr. AUM by geography and asset class: [AMC website]/aum.
pass.note: AUM figure with the breakdown link.

fail.content: We've crossed ₹8,421 cr in AUM — thank you, investors!
fail.note: AUM figure without the AUM-breakdown link.

title: Yield creative required fields
description: A creative showing yield must display the scheme name and description, the annualised Portfolio YTM (semi-annualised YTM to be annualised), the Macaulay Duration, the Residual Maturity, and the 'as on' date, in addition to the applicable product label, risk-o-meter, and standard disclaimers.
source_clause: Internal checklist (Yield creative requirements); MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

pass.content: [AMC] Corporate Bond Fund — Annualised Portfolio YTM: 7.4% | Macaulay Duration: 2.1 yrs | Residual Maturity: 2.6 yrs. Data as on 31 July 2026.

fail.content: Lock in an attractive Portfolio YTM of 7.4%!
fail.note: YTM shown without Macaulay Duration, Residual Maturity, or as-on date.

title: No indicative portfolio or yield
description: Mutual Funds, AMCs, and distributors must not offer any indicative portfolio or indicative yield, and no communication in this regard shall be issued (for open-ended schemes).

pass.content: The scheme invests in high-quality debt; yields are market-linked and not indicated in advance.

fail.content: Expected indicative yield of ~9% p.a. based on our target portfolio.

title: Anniversary creative required disclosures
description: An anniversary post must disclose the Scheme AUM or MF AUM with a link to AUM by geography and asset class, the count of live folios (in line with the MCR), the data 'as on' date, and the date of inception.

pass.content: Celebrating 5 years. Scheme AUM: ₹8,421 cr (AUM by geography/asset class: [AMC website]/aum). Live folios: 1,20,540. Data as on 31 July 2026. Inception: 10 May 2013.
pass.note: AUM link + folio count + as-on date + inception all present.

fail.content: Celebrating 5 amazing years with you — here's to many more!
fail.note: Missing AUM link, folio count, as-on date, and inception date.
